explication: The visible repository slice is a developer test toolbox for the Namma Yatri mobility platform, rather than the ride-service runtime itself. Engineers use its dashboard to run ride/API scenarios and inspect coverage, logs, finance, and remote environments; supporting services provide local context, mock integrations, configuration transfer, and load-test execution. The main workflow is clear at the dashboard level, but several service connections are only partially shown, so those links are omitted or marked unverified.
